observations.trace: Historical6533 get_or_create_pipeline_validated takes a boolean blocking_validation and conditionally pushes a native scope; 95e takes ValidationObservation and calls start_scope. Current borrowed contexts select Uncaptured, while newly owned native contexts select BlockingScopes. The separate current ValidationScopeError retains native/poll types, but this pipeline still stores a popped native error as String and ignores its poll result.
observations.remaining: Original353 and earlier source review already documented the retained-string cause; current observation variants are not evidence every caller shares a policy. Historical and current pipeline bodies differ and are independently preserved. No pipeline, validation scope or GPU ran.

observations.trace: The public bind helper and ComputePass.record each have separate Mat3 arms with the same coarse offset+member.size guard, member.size/3 stride and three-by-three f32 element writes. The prior conditional 12-byte member/block and Mat3 mismatch therefore has the same source-level out-of-bounds request at each distinct operation.
observations.remaining: Original151 and delegate2331 already identified ABI and Mat3 admission as open; the helper and compute-pass sites remain distinct, and the cached fast packer is not asserted to share this precise operation. No reflection, shader, buffer or slice ran.

observations.trace: ReflectedInterface accumulates groups in a BTreeMap keyed by actual group number, then pushes only present layouts and reflection records into compact vectors. ComputePipeline publishes the dense vector to the native PipelineLayoutDescriptor, whose pinned wgpu source says array position names the set number. ComputePass uses the retained original index to get a layout, then later binds built groups by enumeration position.
observations.remaining: Original370 and earlier independently attributed Lens11 626/627 already identified the same first compaction failure and native position rule; the hypothetical sparse group is conditional on supported shader policy and earlier validation may reject before record. No shader, device or native operation ran.

observations.trace: GroupBuilder.uniform overwrites a single uniform_binding and uniform_buffer_size for every uniform resource in a group while accumulating members and layout entries. Image reflection matches dimension and class while discarding other image fields, hard-codes multisampled false, selects WriteOnly for any STORE bit, and classifies all samplers as Filtering.
observations.remaining: Earlier e275 Lens11 delegate626 explicitly recorded these distinct questions. They are conditional on admitted multiple blocks or texture/sampler features; the API may deliberately restrict supported shader shapes. No shader, reflection or GPU ran, and no shared remedy implies aliasing these different operations.

observations.trace: ComputeShader exposes code and module separately; ComputePipeline.prepare reflects the code, while pipeline creation uses the module. ComputePipeline exposes shader, layouts and reflection, and Clone shares pipeline_cache. The cache key hashes only entry_point and returns a hit before reading device, module or layouts.
observations.remaining: Original Adler150 qualification and earlier e275 Lens11 delegate626 already raised mutable shader and cache identity. Public divergent values or cross-device use are conditional, with actual producer ownership and intended immutable lifecycle unresolved. No pipeline, device, mutation or cache lookup ran.

observations.trace: On cache hit get_or_create_pipeline_validated returns before reading validation_observation or starting a scope. Consequently an earlier cached result obtained under Uncaptured is returned to a later BlockingScopes call without a new creation scope. Current context sources use both policies for different device ownership.
observations.remaining: This is an observation-state policy question, not proof an invalid pipeline exists or a later caller requires retroactive validation. Actual sharing across contexts and error handling remain open. No device or validation ran.

observations.contract: Poisoned validation lock and native scope cleanup
observations.trace: ComputePass.record checks retained validation errors only inside if let Ok(lock), so a poisoned lock bypasses that check. ComputePipeline.compile separately converts lock poisoning to an error. Pinned wgpu ErrorScopeGuard Drop pops a scope even if shader.module is missing and the function returns early.
observations.remaining: The pass path is conditional on a poisoned lock and any meaningful retained error, with no panic/poison observed. The suspected leaked-scope claim is rejected for the inspected wgpu version; dropped captured errors and all other exits remain separate questions.

observations.trace: Historical queue339–351 and354–358 separately name missing pipeline/reflection/layout and resource/type conditions, plus pipeline cache/lock/module/entry/reflection conditions. Current source still expresses those selected first checks as separate anyhow prose.
observations.remaining: Preserve each original identity and distinguish it from same-worded errors in the separate bind helper; shared repair machinery does not establish aliases. Actual caller need for structured reasons and global aliases remain open. No error ran.
